use_when: workspace development mode list status suggestion selection definition update disable or review request
framework application skeleton dependency workspace or ownership role is ambiguous
a task may require a different accepted workspace perspective

conditional_context.when: shared root context is enabled and applicable
one proposed or accepted mode is selected
mode suggestion configuration or selection is requested
a mode is accepted changed disabled removed or used for state-changing work

expand_when: workspace identity scope relationship ownership or adapter role conflicts
a selected mode references missing or stale context
mode configuration would change protected project facts
budget_behavior: load the compact catalog first, then one selected mode descriptor and only applicable root or supporting context
